Nora Patel: Candidate Emil Novak (Senior ML Infra) is coming from Prague (CET). Wants a hybrid day on Aug 10. He asked if we can provide a short employer letter for his employer to sign off (he's on a short sabbatical), and noted he needs a quiet room and low-scent environment. Can P-Ops handle badge + letter?
Ellen Park: I can draft the employer letter. Need Emil's full legal name, company name, and exact visit times. We usually turn these around in 2 business days.
Tariq Khan: Office preference? We have Palo Alto and NYC offices free that week. Palo Alto has low-scent policy Friday mornings; NY office has an accessible quiet room. Emil prefers morning CET -> that's afternoon PT. He also asked about a laptop loaner for constrained time (will only be onsite 90m).
Nora Patel: Use Palo Alto. Emil's details: emil.novak@example.com, passport name Emil Novak, +420 777 888 999. Visit window: Aug 10, remote interviews 08:00-11:00 CET, onsite 15:00-16:30 PT if invited. He requested printed badge and a low-scent sign.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: employer letters must include dates, host contact, and a statement of visit purpose. Submit to people-ops@redwood.com with subject "Employer Letter - [Candidate]". Low-scent requests: notify office-facilities@redwood.com 48h prior.
Ellen Park: Draft done and sent to Nora for ok. I'll cc Emil when finalized.
Tariq Khan: I'll reserve the quiet room and add a low-scent notice at reception. Badge prereg ready; printed badge pickup at 14:45. Loaner laptop: we can hold an M2 MacBook at the desk if requested; please request via asset-requests@redwood.com at least 24h before.
Nora Patel: Sent draft to Emil. He replied: "Confirm onsite, printed badge please, I will need the laptop for a short test. I appreciate the low-scent note."
people-ops-bot: Note saved: "Emil Novak - employer letter request completed; low-scent + quiet room; loaner MacBook reserved pending asset request."
Ellen Park: Action items: Nora to forward signed employer letter to candidate; Tariq to confirm loaner hold; people-ops to notify facilities. Closing loop by EOD Fri.
Nora Patel: Thanks all, will follow up once Emil sends employer sign-off.
